      <title>Collision of two trains in Egypt kills at least seven</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/egypt-two-trains-deadly-collision</link>
      <description><p>President orders prompt investigation after one train derails in collision in al-Ayyat about 50km from Cairo</p><p>Seven people were killed and at least 125 injured when two trains collided on Sunday south of the Egyptian capital, Cairo, officials said.</p><p>The crash occurred in al-Ayyat district in Giza province, about 50km (30 miles) south of Cairo, when a train travelling to Fayoum province crashed into the rear of a train heading to the southern province of Aswan, according to the transport ministry.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/egypt-two-trains-deadly-collision">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Kenyan doomsday sect leader jailed for 200 years for murder of 190 children</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie</link>
      <description><p>Paul Mackenzie convicted over deaths of children and one adult after followers were ordered to starve themselves and their families</p><p>The leader of a Kenyan doomsday sect has been sentenced to 200 years in prison for the murders of 190 children and one adult in one of the world’s worst cult disasters in recent history.</p><p>The sentence, comprising 100 years for murder by starvation and 100 years by direct homicide, came two weeks after the court in Kenya’s coastal city of Mombasa <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/oct/19/kenya-starvation-cult-leader-guilty-murder-190-children">found the cult leader guilty</a> of the crimes.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/kenyan-doomsday-sect-leader-jailed-murders-paul-mackenzie">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>ANC faces bruising defeat in South African local elections with 80% of ballots counted</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections</link>
      <description><p>Former liberation movement’s share of national vote almost 14 percentage points below 2021 result</p><p>The African National Congress is on course to suffer a bruising defeat in South Africa’s local elections, with the once dominant party of Nelson Mandela falling to under a third of the vote nationally with more than 80% of ballots counted.</p><p>Wednesday’s fragmented vote marks another stage in the decline of the ANC, which has led national governments since the end of white minority apartheid rule in 1994. High unemployment, crime, corruption and poor local service delivery have all contributed to <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/anc-south-africa-local-elections-water-outages-power-cuts">voters turning away from the party</a>.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/06/anc-faces-defeat-south-african-local-elections">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Patient is ⁠in ​stable condition and will be transferred to a specialist ‘high consequence’ infectious disease unit</p><p>A British healthcare worker with Ebola is being evacuated from the Democratic Republic of the Congo to the UK for medical treatment, it has been confirmed.</p><p>“A British citizen currently in the DR Congo has tested positive for Ebola,” a spokesperson for the UK government said in a statement on Wednesday. “The UK has well-established procedures for dealing with cases like this, and those processes have been activated … The risk to the UK public from Ebola remains low.”</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/04/british-healthcare-worker-ebola-evacuated-drc-to-uk-document-shows">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/popes-visit-to-argentina-sets-up-showdown-with-hyper-capitalist-milei</link>
      <description><p>President has opposing views on many issues, and once called Leo’s predecessor the ‘representative of the Evil One’</p><p>Trees are being planted in the garden. The brightly coloured buildings are getting another coat of paint. The choir rehearses. Hundreds of other residents, several of them using wheelchairs, practise their positions outside the sanctuary. Excitement is in the air, because on Monday 9 November, the Cottolengo Don Orione – a Catholic-run home for disabled people – will be the first stop on Pope Leo XIV’s first full day of his trip to Argentina.</p><p>But the pope’s visit to Claypole, about 26km from Buenos Aires, does not come at an especially happy time for the home, which counts about 400 residents with disabilities. Argentina’s president, Javier Milei, has made wide-ranging cuts to disability funding.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/popes-visit-to-argentina-sets-up-showdown-with-hyper-capitalist-milei">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Farmers face big drop in production from extreme weather during this year’s super El Niño event</p><p>Banana producers in Latin America are calling for better pay to help cope with the impact of the climate crisis, as they face big drops in production resulting from extreme weather during this year’s super El Niño event.</p><p>High winds in parts of Colombia, one of the biggest suppliers to the UK market where droughts are predicted in some regions this year, and heavy rainfall in Peru and Ecuador are already affecting production, according to the Fairtrade Foundation ethical trade body. In the Dominican Republic, farmers are expected to face drought conditions, with forecasts of drier and warmer than usual conditions.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/08/banana-producers-in-latin-america-want-better-pay-to-cope-with-effects-of-climate-crisis">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Assault on Michel Zecler in 2020 is rare case of police brutality reaching court, at time of heightened tensions</p><p>Three French police officers are to go on trial over the beating of a black music producer who they say was not wearing a face mask during the Covid pandemic, in a rare case of police brutality reaching court.</p><p>The assault on Michel Zecler, now 47, triggered outrage in France over police violence, which victims and researchers say is systemic but authorities and law enforcement unions claim is limited to isolated cases.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/09/french-police-officers-face-trial-over-beating-of-black-man-not-wearing-mask-during-covid">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Kraków shooting suspect who killed six has died, say police in Poland</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/09/krakow-shooting-suspected-gunman-dead</link>
      <description><p>Terrorism investigation continues after 24-year-old opened fire in market square, leaving 16 injured</p><p>A gunman who killed six people, including a British man, and injured 16 in a rare mass shooting in a busy market square in Kraków has died in hospital, Polish police said.</p><p>The suspect, a 24-year-old Polish national who has not yet been officially named, opened fire in the city’s main square on Saturday afternoon in an attack that a government minister said was probably influenced by far-right ideologies.       <description><p>From Serbia to Bangladesh and India to France, young people are pushing back against authoritarianism and reshaping political landscapes</p><p>In Brazil, they rallied online by the millions, sharing videos and spreading memes.       <title>Two police officers hailed as heroes for confronting Kraków gunman</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/two-police-officers-heroes-confronting-krakow-gunman-poland</link>
      <description><p>Jakub Kulik critically injured and Artur Morański also wounded after actions that ‘prevented further casualties’</p><p>Two Polish police officers who were injured as they pursued and detained the gunman in Kraków on Saturday have been hailed as heroes.</p><p>One of them is Jakub Kulik, a former paratrooper and volunteer firefighter, who was left critically injured after a close-range exchange of fire with the suspect, <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/07/krakow-poland-shooting-market-square-deaths-gunman">a 24-year-old Polish national who killed six and injured 17</a> in an attack believed to have been inspired by far-right ideologies.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/world/2026/nov/08/two-police-officers-heroes-confronting-krakow-gunman-poland">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Trump may have lost but don’t bet Democrats can fix the economy</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/07/democrats-economy-affordability-crisis</link>
      <description><p>There’s not much they can do over the next couple of years to alleviate angry voters’ stress over prices</p><p>It was the economy, again. Although Donald Trump largely ignored it, voters’ acute concerns over the rising cost of living fuelled a political upheaval for the ages that is likely to deliver the biggest swing toward Democrats since Watergate, granting them the largest House majority in nearly four decades alongside their biggest edge in the Senate since 2008.</p><p>Still, having come to power promising to restore affordability, the new crop of Democrats are soon to discover that there is not much they can do over the next couple of years to alleviate angry voters’ stress over pricey gas and groceries, exorbitant mortgages and unaffordable healthcare.</p><p>Eduardo Porter is a journalist focused on economics and politics. He writes the newsletter <a href="https://eduardoelreportero.substack.com/">Being There</a> on Substack</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/07/democrats-economy-affordability-crisis">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>US job growth exceeds expectations in October despite economic uncertainty</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/06/us-job-growth-october</link>
      <description><p>‘Low-hire, low-fire’ labor market shows sluggish growth but few layoffs, with an interest rate hike expected in December</p><p>The US added 165,000 jobs to the economy in October, a sign of resilience in the labor market amid ongoing war in the Middle East and inflation, according to new data released on Friday.</p><p>Economists had said the labor market has been stuck in a “low-hire, low-fire” state, in which job growth is sluggish but layoffs also remain low, but October’s data surpassed economist expectations. The <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/usemployment">unemployment rate</a> went down slightly to 4.1%, the Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) reported.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/06/us-job-growth-october">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Polling done for the Guardian shows plummeting support from a former key constituency of Donald Trump’s base</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/community/live/2026/nov/05/what-happens-after-the-blue-wave-our-reporters-answer-your-midterm-election-results-questions">Q&amp;A: Ask your questions about Democrats’ win in the midterms</a></p></li></ul><p>Polling conducted by the Harris Poll for the Guardian before the election shows just how angry voters were and points to one key reason Republicans lost so badly: plummeting support from rural voters, once a key constituency of Donald Trump’s base.</p><p>Over the summer, 95% of Americans indicated they believed there was an <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/07/cost-of-living-poll-groceries-gas">affordability crisis</a>, particularly because of steep gas and grocery prices.       <link>https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/04/us-dollar-slides-democrats-midterm-election-win-growth-fears</link>
      <description><p>Government bond yields fall while initial fears ease over impact of election results on world’s biggest economy</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/04/midterm-elections-results-senate-house-michigan-maine-mississippi-latest-updates">US midterm elections – live updates</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/04/explainer-midterms-trump-us-global-economy-markets">After US midterms, what will lame-duck Trump mean for global economy?</a></p></li></ul><p>US stocks have surged as investors digest the Democrats’ victories in the <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/us-midterm-elections-2026">midterm elections</a>, lifted by hopes that <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/donaldtrump">Donald Trump</a>’s turbulent policymaking would be restrained and shaking off initial fears about the impact on growth in the world’s largest economy.</p><p>The Dow Jones rose close to 3%, its best day in over a year, while the tech-heavy Nasdaq and the benchmark S&amp;P 500 gained about 1.5% each when markets closed on Wednesday afternoon, turning around overnight falls in US stock futures after the news that the Democratic party <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/03/midterm-election-results-live-updates">won control</a> of the Senate and the House of Representatives.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/nov/04/us-dollar-slides-democrats-midterm-election-win-growth-fears">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <description><p>Fox News pundits hardly criticized the US president in midterms coverage but Trump was still quick to cast blame</p><ul><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/live/2026/nov/05/midterm-elections-live-latest-updates-mississippi-senate-race">US midterms 2026 live – latest updates</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/ng-interactive/2026/nov/03/midterm-elections-full-results-senate-house-governor-races">Track live results from all 50 states</a></p></li><li><p><a href="https://www.theguardian.com/community/live/2026/nov/05/what-happens-after-the-blue-wave-our-reporters-answer-your-midterm-election-results-questions">Q&amp;A: Ask your questions about Democrats’ win in the midterms</a></p></li></ul><p>In the weeks leading up to Tuesday’s midterm elections, <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/28/trump-fox-news-truth-social">Donald Trump made clear that he would place some blame on his favorite cable channel</a>, Fox News, if his party did poorly.</p><p>On election day, he didn’t disappoint.</p><p>This article was amended on 4 November 2026; a previous version incorrectly stated that Karoline Leavitt is Donald Trump’s most recent press secretary, when it is in fact Katie Zacharia.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/nov/04/trump-blames-fox-news-republican-losses">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>The survival of American democracy depends on taxing billionaires</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/27/democracy-tax-billionaires</link>
      <description><p>It is essential not just to fund the public goods the nation needs, it is indispensable to restore a sense of fairness</p><p>Money doesn’t buy happiness, we’re told. Even some economists agree. The Nobel prize-winning economists Daniel Kahneman and Angus Deaton once <a href="https://www.pnas.org/doi/full/10.1073/pnas.1011492107">proposed that</a> rising income increased people’s emotional wellbeing only up to a ceiling of about $115,000 in today’s money.</p><p>They probably hadn’t met many billionaires. The ultra-rich may not pursue happiness in the joyful sense of the word. But they will try every trick in the book to hang on to their stash and woe betide the tax authority that tries to lay a finger on their treasure.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/us-news/2026/oct/27/democracy-tax-billionaires">Continue reading...</a></description>

A week after shootings in the Paris suburbs of Trappes and La Verrière that are being investigated as a terrorist attack motivated by race, the mayor of Trappes has called for the "great replacement" theory – which claims white French people are being deliberately replaced by non-Europeans – to be banned by law.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/73ca4158-d483-11f1-8054-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/AP24094743230701.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/73ca4158-d483-11f1-8054-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/AP24094743230701.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ec23f022-d44c-11f1-9a4a-8d24f1bca529</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 17:47:01 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/73ca4158-d483-11f1-8054-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/AP24094743230701.jpg">AP - Laurent Cipriani</source><dc:creator>Alison Hird</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French dockworkers strike over budget measures and militarisation of ports</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261030-french-dockworkers-strike-over-budget-measures-and-militarisation-of-ports-arms-war</link><description>
French ports are expected to be almost completely shut down on Friday as dockworkers join a 24-hour strike across 22 countries to protest against the use of ports for arms exports. French workers are also demonstrating against proposed measures in the country's draft budget. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/d25f3b80-1569-11ec-a3d6-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/000_Par2521606.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/d25f3b80-1569-11ec-a3d6-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/000_Par2521606.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">e5d1f3dc-d432-11f1-82fd-876b12b9de9a</guid><pubDate>Fri, 30 Oct 2026 08:19:09 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/d25f3b80-1569-11ec-a3d6-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/000_Par2521606.jpg">AFP - ROBERT FRANCOIS</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Paris suburb shooting suspect 'targeted Muslims, Africans or North Africans'</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261029-paris-suburb-shooting-suspect-targeted-muslims-africans-or-north-africans</link><description>
The man being held over the shootings which took place last Friday in the Paris suburbs of Trappes and La Verrière – which left one man dead and several people wounded, including an 11-year-old girl – has said he specifically targeted people of Muslim, African or North African appearance, anti-terrorism investigators revealed on Thursday.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/b8499e0a-cff6-11f1-a35a-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D4AX6UN.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/b8499e0a-cff6-11f1-a35a-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D4AX6UN.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">59bc4dbe-d38f-11f1-83b1-93c98f0401df</guid><pubDate>Thu, 29 Oct 2026 14:46:06 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/b8499e0a-cff6-11f1-a35a-4b25c96ec90e/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D4AX6UN.jpg">© Simon Wohlfahrt / AFP</source><dc:creator>Paul Myers</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>US judge narrows Macrons' defamation lawsuit against American podcaster</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261029-us-judge-narrows-macrons-defamation-lawsuit-against-american-podcaster</link><description>
A judge in the United States has ruled that French President Emmanuel Macron and his wife Brigitte ​could continue their defamation lawsuit against the companies of the American podcaster Candace Owens, but not against Owens herself.

</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/adc76f8c-cd55-11f1-9456-8bea73bbe173/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-21T125049Z-1626714977-RC2O7OAWSBDT-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/adc76f8c-cd55-11f1-9456-8bea73bbe173/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-21T125049Z-1626714977-RC2O7OAWSBDT-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">c71b5e2c-d2ae-11f1-aba7-f34b6a3fdc30</guid><pubDate>Wed, 28 Oct 2026 11:09:11 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/adc76f8c-cd55-11f1-9456-8bea73bbe173/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-10-21T125049Z-1626714977-RC2O7OAWSBDT-RTRMADP-3-FRANCE-PROTEST.jpg">© REUTERS - Manon Cruz </source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French media protest manhandling of journalists at far-right party rally</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/en/france/20261028-french-media-protest-manhandling-of-journalists-at-far-right-party-rally</link><description>

      <title>Premier League: 10 talking points from the weekend’s action</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/09/premier-league-10-talking-points-weekend-action</link>
      <description><p>Delap’s talents resurface in style, Gómez delights Brighton with more fireworks, and hair-pulling confusion at Everton</p><p>It would have been very easy for Oliver Glasner to lose patience with Liam Delap. The forward is still only 23, yet the days when he was rattling in 12 in a Premier League season for Ipswich have come to seem a very long time ago (and his six games for Manchester City even longer). A season at Chelsea had left him bereft of confidence, an odd mix of diffidence and overaggression, devoid of composure in the box, arms flailing like a broken windmill. But the old gifts have not left him. Both goals on Saturday were the result of great muscular surges and if the first finish seemed essentially about hitting the ball as hard as possible on target, the second was a precise – and still powerful – finish in off the far post. After games such as this it’s possible to imagine him as England’s long-term replacement for Harry Kane. <strong>Jonathan Wilson</strong></p><p><em>Match report:</em> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/nottingham-forest-manchester-city-premier-league-match-report">Nottingham Forest 3-1 Manchester City</a></p><p><em>Match report:</em> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/08/manchester-united-aston-villa-premier-league-match-report">Manchester United 4-4 Aston Villa</a></p><p><em>Match report:</em> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/08/brighton-brentford-premier-league-match-report">Brighton 2-0 Brentford</a></p><p><em>Match report:</em> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/arsenal-hull-premier-league-match-report">Arsenal 1-0 Hull</a></p><p><em>Match report:</em> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/08/sunderland-chelsea-premier-league-match-report">Sunderland 1-0 Chelsea</a></p><p><em>Match report:</em> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/leeds-tottenham-premier-league-match-report">Leeds 1-0 Tottenham</a></p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/09/premier-league-10-talking-points-weekend-action">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Barcelona move clear at the top after Fermín López’s double stuns Atlético Madrid</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/08/atletico-madrid-barcelona-la-liga-match-report</link>
      <description><p>They had been in a battle, they had been behind and they had been on edge, but Barcelona found a way through, holding on to their place at the top of the table and holding the doubts at bay for another day. A fortnight in which they were defeated by Paris Saint-Germain <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/oct/25/barcelona-real-madrid-el-clasico-la-liga-match-report">and Real Madrid</a>, in which they might have wondered if something was not right, ended with a 2-1 win at Atlético Madrid. This was a proper test and a proper game, 10 World Cup winners on the field and first place awaiting the winner, and at the end of an intense enjoyable night, that was Hansi Flick’s side.</p><p>At a noisy Metropolitano, the atmosphere matching the occasion, against a frenetic Atlético side that went for the throat, Barcelona trailed to a Giuliano Simeone goal and for a while in a frenzied first half it looked like there may be no way back. But they found it, two goals from Fermín López either side of the break leading them to the kind of victory that brings a reward beyond the points. It hadn’t been easy but they had made it; ultimately, they might conclude they had found a way to manage it too, some satisfaction in the suffering, in how they resisted and re-established control amid the chaos.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/08/atletico-madrid-barcelona-la-liga-match-report">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/08/brighton-brentford-premier-league-match-report</link>
      <description><p></p><p>Who can stop Brighton’s ­ascension in English and European football? They are setting standards, ­practices ­leaving almost everybody else ­trailing in their wake. A ­second‑place position in the ­Premier&nbsp;League would once have read like a glitch in a ­Football ­Manager ­session. Not in November 2026, where they appear the only team capable of throwing down any sort of challenge to Arsenal.</p><p>Under low winter sun, Brentford, an opposition to which Brighton are often, if lazily, compared, were ­swatted aside. If Keith Andrews’s team, and their fans at the Amex&nbsp;­Stadium, could level blame at a couple of ­refereeing decisions, they received little chance of rescuing anything. Brighton squeezed them, toyed with them.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/08/brighton-brentford-premier-league-match-report">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/scottish-premiership-roundup-rangers-st-mirren-aberdeen-hibernian-dundee-united-motherwell-st-johnstone</link>
      <description><ul><li><p>Falkirk leapfrog their hosts with 5-2 rout at Tynecastle</p></li><li><p>Liam Scales gives Celtic 1-0 home win over Kilmarnock </p></li></ul><p><strong>Falkirk</strong> obliterated <strong>Hearts</strong>’ 18-month unbeaten home record in the Scottish Premiership with a stunning 5-2 win at Tynecastle on Sunday as they leapfrogged their hosts into third place.</p><p>Wouter Vrancken’s beleaguered side, missing 11 players through injury, were in disarray as Falkirk romped into a five-goal lead early in the second half through Finley Barbrook, Owen Eames, Liam Henderson and Jacob Murrell’s double.       <description><p>Questions over whether Álvaro Arbeloa and Matthias Jaissle have what it takes to succeed in the Premier League remain unanswered after these two young foreign managers watched their sides grind out a 1-1 draw at Craven Cottage.</p><p>Arbeloa’s Fulham lacked fizz, physicality and personality before rescuing a point thanks to a late equaliser from Rodrigo Muniz, while Newcastle displayed little of Jaissle’s high-octane philosophy and squandered the chance to move into the top half after failing to build on a vicious opening goal from Jacob Murphy.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/fulham-newcastle-premier-league-match-report">Continue reading...</a></description>

    <item>

      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/lionel-messi-mls-golden-boot-inter-miami-charlotte-nashville-playoffs</link>
      <description><ul><li><p>Messi first to win consecutive MLS Golden Boots</p></li><li><p>Inter Miami surrender 3-0 lead in dramatic draw </p></li><li><p>Nashville set new league record with 77 points</p></li></ul><p>Lionel Messi won his second consecutive MLS Golden Boot award on Saturday, but Inter Miami squandered a three-goal lead in a 3-3 draw with Charlotte on the final day of the regular season.</p><p>The Argentinian superstar failed to score but set up Miami’s first two goals from corners at Nu Stadium as the defending champions secured second place in the Eastern Conference and home-field advantage for the first two rounds of the playoffs.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/lionel-messi-mls-golden-boot-inter-miami-charlotte-nashville-playoffs">Continue reading...</a></description>

      <title>Enzo Maresca rues Manchester City’s lack of desire after defeat at Nottingham Forest</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/enzo-maresca-nottingham-forest-manchester-city-premier-league</link>
      <description><ul><li><p>‘You need desire and intensity … we didn’t match them’</p></li><li><p>City have now lost three successive league matches</p></li></ul><p>Enzo Maresca blamed his side’s lack of desire and the way they were outgunned in duels for a third successive Premier League defeat. After winning their first seven games of the season, <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/nottingham-forest-manchester-city-premier-league-match-report">Manchester City’s 3-1 loss at Nottingham Forest</a> extended their poor run.</p><p>Jair Cunha dispossessed Josko Gvardiol to score the opener, then Liam Delap struck twice with muscular surges on the break as Forest won their first home league game since April. “Today I think [the problem] has been general,” said Maresca. “It’s not about one player. In the first half we lost all the duels, all the contacts. Against this team, that is fighting relegation, if you don’t match them … it’s something we need to understand. In this kind of game, if you’re not able to win duels and second balls like in the first half, you struggle.</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/enzo-maresca-nottingham-forest-manchester-city-premier-league">Continue reading...</a></description>

    <item>
      <title>Rise of the ‘schooligans’: how a wave of antisocial behaviour threatens non-league football</title>
      <link>https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/antisocial-behaviour-non-league-football-youth-hooligans-police</link>
      <description><p>Teenage ultras are increasingly causing disorder and communities fear it will not be long before it becomes something more dangerous</p><p>It is five past three on Saturday afternoon and the teenage ultras of Hednesford Town are running late. They have arrived in Chester for their team’s National League North fixture and have hailed taxis, determined to make their presence felt at the ground. But word appears to have got out about their arrival. As one car turns away from the city’s charming half-timbered houses and into narrow residential streets, half a dozen local youths appear, haring round the corner in balaclavas. They try to attack the cab and chase after it as it pulls away. The smell of pyro is everywhere. As the taxi finally gets clear, the Chester gang stops in the middle of the road, shouting and gesticulating. One lad, no older than 16, pulls a long blade from inside his trousers and brandishes it.</p><p>The incident ended there and no one was hurt, though a police investigation has been launched. The match went off without trouble too and the Hednesford gang – known at home as the “schooligans” – were escorted safely back to the station by Cheshire police. It was just another weekend in English non-league football, where a wave of antisocial behaviour is causing concern and leading the UK Football Policing Unit (UKFPU) to declare it its “most important” priority. As the disorder continues, a question remains: how long will it be before teenage trouble-making becomes something more dangerous?</p> <a href="https://www.theguardian.com/football/2026/nov/07/antisocial-behaviour-non-league-football-youth-hooligans-police">Continue reading...</a></description>

An insider look at French politics, culture, society, technology and sport through on-the-ground reports, investigations, exclusive interviews, debates and analyses.</description><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/</link><lastBuildDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:52:51 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.france24.com/en/france/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>France</category><title>Paris police officers go on trial over 2020 beating of Black man</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261109-paris-police-officers-go-on-trial-over-2020-beating-of-black-man</link><description>
Three French police officers will go on trial Monday over the 2020 beating of Black music producer Michel Zecler in Paris. The assault, which was captured on camera, sparked nationwide outrage and renewed scrutiny of police violence and racism in France.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/dba8d6a2-dc23-11f1-9698-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6VU4CT.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/dba8d6a2-dc23-11f1-9698-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6VU4CT.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">476e3e4a-dc24-11f1-9f04-f3d8b2b0702c</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:08:03 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/dba8d6a2-dc23-11f1-9698-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6VU4CT.jpg">© Thomas Samson, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Controversial West African activist Kemi Seba detained in Paris</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20241015-controversial-west-african-activist-kemi-seba-detained-in-paris</link><description>
Kemi Seba, a controversial African activist known for his virulent anti-Western stance, has been arrested in Paris, a source close to the case told AFP Tuesday.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d792557e-8afa-11ef-b7b5-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000_1U53IC.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d792557e-8afa-11ef-b7b5-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000_1U53IC.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b9cb5c02-8aff-11ef-811f-005056a97652</guid><pubDate>Tue, 15 Oct 2024 14:17:13 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d792557e-8afa-11ef-b7b5-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/000_1U53IC.jpg">© Stéphane de Sakutin, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France’s new health pass rules raise questions as many scramble to adapt</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20210714-france-s-new-health-pass-rules-raise-questions-as-many-scramble-to-adapt</link><description>
While the extension of France’s health pass and other new anti-Covid 19 measures announced by President Emmanuel Macron Monday night are yet to be hammered out in detail, what’s certain is that a full-throttled return to a normal life of frequenting café terraces, restaurants, cinemas, theatres and other culture and leisure activities will now hinge on having a pass sanitaire (or health pass).
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/95a7a1f4-e018-11eb-931e-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/61be21e7dd8409eb6f2604b7d2e8d59f8e2865dc.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/95a7a1f4-e018-11eb-931e-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/61be21e7dd8409eb6f2604b7d2e8d59f8e2865dc.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">5823e86e-e4b0-11eb-8c07-005056bf762b</guid><pubDate>Wed, 14 Jul 2021 16:03:14 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/95a7a1f4-e018-11eb-931e-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/61be21e7dd8409eb6f2604b7d2e8d59f8e2865dc.jpg">© Sameer Al-Doumy, AFP</source><dc:creator>Romain BRUNET</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Daughter loses legal case in bitter Asterix family feud</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/20131211-daughter-loses-legal-case-bitter-asterix-family-feud-france-comics</link><description>A long-running family feud between Asterix co-creator Albert Uderzo and his daughter took a new twist on Tuesday after judges dismissed a claim by Sylvie Uderzo that her father was mentally frail and being exploited.</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/abe23e78-093f-11e9-b87e-005056a964fe/w:1024/p:16x9/asterix_0.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/abe23e78-093f-11e9-b87e-005056a964fe/w:1024/p:16x9/asterix_0.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">563894c2-cafc-11e7-8241-005056bf73c0</guid><pubDate>Wed, 11 Dec 2013 18:09:33 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/abe23e78-093f-11e9-b87e-005056a964fe/w:1024/p:16x9/asterix_0.jpg">Photo: AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French students vow to continue protests despite concessions from Macron govt</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20261026-macron-vows-concrete-measures-to-address-student-demands-after-unrest</link><description>
French student leaders on Monday called for more protests despite President Emmanuel Macron's pledge of  "concrete and strong" measures to address their demands after weeks of nationwide unrest. Prime Minister Sébastien Lecornu met with high school representatives alongside education ministers to announce follow-up action ranging from a total overhaul of higher education admissions platform Parcoursup to a cap on class sizes.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0691971e-d134-11f1-baaf-4d317af013fd/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26299412584753.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0691971e-d134-11f1-baaf-4d317af013fd/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26299412584753.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">ade564d2-d134-11f1-9bc8-6d20ccb9a352</guid><pubDate>Mon, 26 Oct 2026 12:25:21 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/0691971e-d134-11f1-baaf-4d317af013fd/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26299412584753.jpg">© Aurelien Morissard, AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Top contemporary French artist Christian Boltanski dies aged 76</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20210714-top-contemporary-french-artist-christian-boltanski-dies-aged-76</link><description>
Christian Boltanski, one of France's top contemporary artists whose multimedia works probed the meaning of mortality and memory, has died aged 76, a former museum director told AFP on Sunday.

</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">61b975d6-b32e-11f1-ab9e-b5bbc83805db</guid><pubDate>Fri, 18 Sep 2026 07:23:41 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1b1526be-b330-11f1-abde-1d1125ed9143/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26142371784910.jpg">© Ludovic Marin, AFP via AP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>Radio France staff strike over appointment of far-right weekly editor</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260913-radio-france-staff-strike-over-appointment-of-far-right-weekly-editor</link><description>
Staff at public broadcaster Radio France began a two-day strike on Sunday over the appointment of Charles Sapin, deputy editor-in-chief at far-right weekly Valeurs Actuelles. Unions accuse Sapin of promoting far-right ideas ahead of next spring's presidential election, while management has defended the appointment in the name of pluralism.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/02d53bbe-af04-11f1-9d7b-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/e1d9fdbe2d48d1241c3b6d21d639c8533611857e.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/02d53bbe-af04-11f1-9d7b-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/e1d9fdbe2d48d1241c3b6d21d639c8533611857e.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">5ef9108e-af70-11f1-8f8f-7db7cf189a1f</guid><pubDate>Sun, 13 Sep 2026 12:44:54 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/02d53bbe-af04-11f1-9d7b-005056bf30b7/w:1024/p:16x9/e1d9fdbe2d48d1241c3b6d21d639c8533611857e.jpg">© Ludovic Marin, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>France apologises for diplomatic spat with US to lift block on new ambassador to Washington</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260913-france-apologises-for-diplomatic-spat-with-us-to-lift-block-on-new-ambassador-to-washington</link><description>
The French UN mission said it regretted an online post criticising a US vote at the UN General Assembly in a move that should clear the way for the new French ambassador Aurélien Lechevallier to take up his post in Washington.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8728c102-af4e-11f1-9048-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C2P7793.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8728c102-af4e-11f1-9048-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C2P7793.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">9c8e07e2-af4d-11f1-8c62-892c781611bd</guid><pubDate>Sun, 13 Sep 2026 09:01:17 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8728c102-af4e-11f1-9048-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C2P7793.jpg">© Ludovic Marin, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>French wine yields drop to new historic low after searing summer heat</title><link>https://www.france24.com/en/france/20260907-scorching-summer-pushes-french-wine-harvest-to-new-historic-low</link><description>
French wine production is expected to suffer its worst harvest in some 70 years with the agriculture ministry on Monday forecasting a 6 percent drop in output after a summer of scorching temperatures, heatwaves and drought. France last week announced more than €1 billion in emergency support for farmers.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/45a0454c-aab3-11f1-8ad4-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/f0e62229cbdd19e6bec50a391c5d77395a3a4af6.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/45a0454c-aab3-11f1-8ad4-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/f0e62229cbdd19e6bec50a391c5d77395a3a4af6.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">4694cc16-aab3-11f1-81c9-ff9d54eec782</guid><pubDate>Mon, 07 Sep 2026 11:57:17 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/45a0454c-aab3-11f1-8ad4-005056a90284/w:1024/p:16x9/f0e62229cbdd19e6bec50a391c5d77395a3a4af6.jpg">© Sebastien Salom-Gomis, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item></channel></rss>

Climat, déforestation, orpaillage illégal… L’Amazonie, poumon vert de la planète, est aujourd’hui menacée de toutes parts. Quels sont les périls qui pèsent sur cet écosystème essentiel et quelles sont les conséquences pour les populations qui y vivent ? Pour décrypter les enjeux de cette lutte pour la survie de l’Amazonie, nous accueillons sur notre plateau Bruno Meyerfeld, journaliste au Monde et auteur de Cauchemar brésilien.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d15420fc-dc29-11f1-9e0b-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261109-093259-094053-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d15420fc-dc29-11f1-9e0b-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261109-093259-094053-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">d630299a-dc29-11f1-b111-47725653f478</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:42:56 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Israël : Gadi Eisenkot face au défi de former une large coalition</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261109-isra%C3%ABl-gadi-eisenkot-face-au-d%C3%A9fi-de-former-une-large-coalition</link><description>
Gadi Eisenkot, principal adversaire du Premier ministre israélien ⁠Benjamin Netanyahu, a déclaré ​dimanche vouloir former un large gouvernement de coalition le plus rapidement possible après des élections législatives sans vainqueur clair qui n'ont dégagé aucune majorité.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/69f70736-dc28-11f1-991d-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261109-091140-091621-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/69f70736-dc28-11f1-991d-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261109-091140-091621-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">6eb0f8e0-dc28-11f1-986f-adf1f50055d3</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:33:05 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>La COP31 s'ouvre avec un appel à se montrer à la hauteur face à l'urgence climatique</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261109-la-cop31-s-ouvre-avec-un-appel-%C3%A0-se-montrer-%C3%A0-la-hauteur-face-%C3%A0-l-urgence-climatique</link><description>
La conférence annuelle sur le climat des Nations unies a débuté lundi avec de premiers contentieux sur l'argent à débourser face au changement climatique, le chef de l'ONU appelant les Etats à se montrer à la hauteur face à l'urgence du réchauffement.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/51cb3fc0-dc27-11f1-aace-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261109-110839-110957-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/51cb3fc0-dc27-11f1-aace-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261109-110839-110957-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">56fc4548-dc27-11f1-bd32-e3a7dcfcfc77</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:29:18 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Nvidia : Jensen Huang, patron vedette de l'IA rattrapé par une liaison dangereuse</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261109-nvidia-jensen-huang-patron-vedette-de-l-ia-rattrap%C3%A9-par-une-liaison-dangereuse</link><description>
Plongé par une liaison extra-conjugale dans un scandale d'espionnage chinois présumé, Jensen Huang est devenu avec l'explosion de l'intelligence artificielle (IA) l'un des patrons les plus puissants et visibles au monde.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9024ec3a-dc27-11f1-aede-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261109-111032-111252-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/9024ec3a-dc27-11f1-aede-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261109-111032-111252-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">9553b38a-dc27-11f1-aabd-7540ebaac99e</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:28:40 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>France : une conférence à Matignon pour tenter de répondre aux revendications sociales</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261109-france-une-conf%C3%A9rence-%C3%A0-matignon-pour-tenter-de-r%C3%A9pondre-aux-revendications-sociales</link><description>
Le Premier ministre, Sébastien Lecornu, reçoit ⁠ce lundi matin ​les représentants du patronat et des syndicats du secteur privé afin d'apporter des "réponses concrètes" aux revendications sociales qui ​s'expriment dans la rue depuis la mi-septembre, notamment sur la question du salaire minimum (smic).
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8b054254-dc27-11f1-9769-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261109-110110-110802-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/8b054254-dc27-11f1-9769-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261109-110110-110802-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">9073eb32-dc27-11f1-a180-bf32f5dc36e8</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:28:24 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>En Pologne, les tensions politiques exacerbées après l'attaque de Cracovie</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/europe/20261109-pologne-tensions-politiques-exacerb%C3%A9es-apr%C3%A8s-attaque-cracovie-extreme-droite-tusk</link><description>
Alors que l'auteur de l'attaque de Cracovie est mort de ses blessures lundi à l'hôpital, les enquêteurs poursuivent leurs investigations pour déterminer les motivations de l'assaillant, soupçonné d'avoir été fasciné par les idéologies d'extrême droite. La fusillade, qui a fait au moins six victimes, ravive les tensions politiques en Pologne.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/a15c1840-dc20-11f1-a84c-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-09T084816Z-608081544-RC27KOAOEVB7-RTRMADP-3-POLAND-SHOOTING.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/a15c1840-dc20-11f1-a84c-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-09T084816Z-608081544-RC27KOAOEVB7-RTRMADP-3-POLAND-SHOOTING.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b6c7cc14-dc21-11f1-b5c7-4d8de636de77</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 10:06:19 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/a15c1840-dc20-11f1-a84c-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/2026-11-09T084816Z-608081544-RC27KOAOEVB7-RTRMADP-3-POLAND-SHOOTING.jpg">© Jakub Porzycki, Reuters</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Sports</category><title>Alcaraz vainqueur, Laperche triomphe, l'OM enfonce Lens : les infos sport du week-end</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/sports/20261109-alcaraz-laperche-om-lens-infos-sport-week-end</link><description>
Tom Laperche a remporté la Route du Rhum en un temps record tandis que Carlos Alcaraz a enfin triomphé dans le Masters 1000 de Paris. Enfin, Lens n'a pas su se remettre à l'endroit, renversé par l'OM, quelques jours après l'humiliation en Ligue des champions. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/923906d2-dc22-11f1-8b45-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/recap-sport-09-11-2026-1.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/923906d2-dc22-11f1-8b45-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/recap-sport-09-11-2026-1.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">27c6ee96-dc1c-11f1-94f5-3b21f55c1f8f</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:56:50 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/923906d2-dc22-11f1-8b45-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/recap-sport-09-11-2026-1.png">© Studio graphique FMM</source><dc:creator>Romain HOUEIX</dc:creator></item><item><category>Info éco</category><title>Nvidia : son patron au cœur d'une affaire d'espionnage chinois</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/info-%C3%A9co/20261109-nvidia-son-patron-au-c%C5%93ur-d-une-affaire-d-espionnage-chinois</link><description>
Le géant américain des puces électroniques a ouvert une enquête interne après les révélations sur une possible opération d'espionnage chinois visant son patron, Jensen Huang. Ce dernier a reconnu avoir trompé son épouse. Une affaire aux lourds enjeux économiques et politiques, en pleine guerre technologique entre Washington et Pékin.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e7508f78-dc13-11f1-9cb7-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-090b3e50.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/e7508f78-dc13-11f1-9cb7-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/capture-090b3e50.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">0e6c1b4e-dc10-11f1-b27c-610d63238d56</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:31:02 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Christophe DANSETTE</dc:creator></item><item><category>France</category><title>En direct : Lecornu reçoit syndicats et patronat pour tenter de répondre aux revendications sociales</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/france/20261109-en-direct-lecornu-re%C3%A7oit-syndicats-et-patronat-pour-tenter-de-r%C3%A9pondre-aux-revendications-sociales</link><description>
Sous pression des manifestants et sans marge financière, le Premier ministre Sébastien Lecornu reçoit lundi matin à Matignon les représentants du patronat et des syndicats du secteur privé afin d'apporter des "réponses concrètes" aux revendications sociales qui ​s'expriment dans la rue depuis la mi-septembre, notamment sur la question du Smic, le salaire minimum. Suivez notre direct.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/72a55d8e-dc1d-11f1-882d-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D3Y62PD-1.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/72a55d8e-dc1d-11f1-882d-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D3Y62PD-1.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">d58ea838-dc1d-11f1-b5e0-b3699f6f5d0a</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:17:53 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/72a55d8e-dc1d-11f1-882d-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D3Y62PD-1.jpg">© Julien de Rosa, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>JOJ Dakar 2026 : le champion de boxe Souleymane M’Baye forme la relève</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261109-joj-dakar-2026-le-champion-de-boxe-souleymane-m-baye-forme-la-rel%C3%A8ve</link><description>
🇸🇳Trois fois champion du monde de boxe pour la France, Souleymane M’Baye transmet son exigence à la jeunesse sénégalaise au sein de son académie Keur of Champions à Dakar.
 
🥊 Entre rigueur et ambitions internationales, immersion sur le ring avec ceux qui préparent le futur de la boxe sénégalaise, avec les JO de Los Angeles 2028 en ligne de mire.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/67eea818-db83-11f1-a3a9-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/mini-souleymane.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/67eea818-db83-11f1-a3a9-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/mini-souleymane.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">cd1527ae-db82-11f1-9982-37b0d0b45524</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:42:45 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Sports</category><title>L'OM bat Lens pour sa cinquième victoire consécutive en Ligue 1</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/sports/20261109-om-bat-lens-pour-sa-cinqui%C3%A8me-victoire-cons%C3%A9cutive-en-ligue-1</link><description>
Marseille a battu Lens (2-1) en clôture de la 10ᵉ journée de Ligue 1. Grâce à ce résultat, l'OM est quatrième du classement.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f82883bc-dbe3-11f1-b840-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/om-2.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/f82883bc-dbe3-11f1-b840-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/om-2.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">1539986a-dbe4-11f1-99b8-f9c511616e9c</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:34:08 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>L'Equipe TV</dc:creator></item><item><category>Amériques</category><title>Trump reconnaît une politique d'expulsions des immigrés "trop dure" après sa déroute électorale</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/am%C3%A9riques/20261109-trump-reconna%C3%AEt-politique-expulsions-immigr%C3%A9s-trop-dure-apr%C3%A8s-d%C3%A9route-%C3%A9lectorale-%C3%A9tats-unis</link><description>
Peu après la défaite des républicains aux élections de mi-mandat, le président américain a reconnu des excès dans sa politique migratoire, sans toutefois annoncer de changement concret. Une prise de distance qui intervient alors qu'il vient de confier un poste stratégique à Stephen Miller, artisan des expulsions massives.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d373e164-dc11-11f1-a96a-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26313093851055.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d373e164-dc11-11f1-a96a-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26313093851055.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">1b3a6744-dc11-11f1-b55d-9d0f7fbf1a92</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:13:49 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/d373e164-dc11-11f1-a96a-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26313093851055.jpg">© AP, Nathan Howard</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Dans la presse</category><title>Fermeture du journal russe Novaya Gazeta : "Nous avons été tués"</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/dans-la-presse/20261109-fermeture-de-novaya-gazeta-nous-avons-%C3%A9t%C3%A9-tu%C3%A9s</link><description>
À la une de la presse, ce lundi 9 novembre, la publication du dernier numéro du journal d’opposition russe Novaya Gazeta, symbole du combat pour la démocratie. Un chiffre également à la une : 500. C'est le nombre de jours que le journaliste français Christophe Gleizes aura passé en prison, mercredi. Le début aujourd’hui de la COP31 sur le climat, à Antalya. Un pays hôte très critiqué en matière d’environnement et de droits humains. Et les spéculations sur le nouveau James Bond.

La paracycliste française de 32 ans Tifany Huot-Marchand est devenue triple championne du monde sur piste. Une résurrection pour cette ancienne patineuse de vitesse, victime d'un terrible accident en compétition en 2022. Les médecins lui avaient annoncé qu'elle ne pourrait probablement plus jamais marcher. Après une longue rééducation, Tifany s'est tournée vers le paracyclisme où elle fait désormais partie des meilleures du monde. Prochain objectif : les Jeux Paralympiques de Los Angeles 2028.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1850aa0c-dbc6-11f1-8d80-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/FRA-NEWS-08-11-2026-19-59-ING10-CLEAN-N2.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1850aa0c-dbc6-11f1-8d80-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/FRA-NEWS-08-11-2026-19-59-ING10-CLEAN-N2.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">b124b3b4-dbc5-11f1-b08c-6b8491c73bd8</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 22:49:10 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Asie-Pacifique</category><title>Le patron de Nvidia éclaboussé par une affaire extraconjugale avec une espionne chinoise présumée</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/asie-pacifique/20261108-le-patron-de-nvidia-%C3%A9clabouss%C3%A9-par-une-affaire-extraconjugale-avec-une-espionne-chinoise-pr%C3%A9sum%C3%A9e</link><description>
Jensen Huang a reconnu avoir eu une relation extraconjugale avec une femme soupçonnée d'être une agente de Pékin. Il a assuré de sa pleine coopération avec les investigations lancées par le conseil d'administration de Nvidia, qui a ouvert une enquête indépendante. Donald Trump lui a accordé sa confiance. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2bb81dfe-cd49-11f1-80c0-eb48fa034ddc/w:1024/p:16x9/6816aa54a64f20da410fe06c62ff522af2f50eb2.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2bb81dfe-cd49-11f1-80c0-eb48fa034ddc/w:1024/p:16x9/6816aa54a64f20da410fe06c62ff522af2f50eb2.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">7e839eee-dbc4-11f1-9317-b305bbe44502</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 22:34:00 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/2bb81dfe-cd49-11f1-80c0-eb48fa034ddc/w:1024/p:16x9/6816aa54a64f20da410fe06c62ff522af2f50eb2.jpg">© John Macdougall, AFP</source><dc:creator>FRANCE 24</dc:creator></item><item><category>Journal de l'Afrique</category><title>Dialogue nationale en RD Congo : comment sortir de l'impasse ?</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/%C3%A9missions/journal-de-l-afrique/20261108-dialogue-nationale-en-rd-congo-comment-sortir-de-l-impasse</link><description>
Alors que la guerre se poursuit dans l'Est, cinq grandes figures de l'opposition, réunies au sein de la coalition C64, veulent rencontrer Félix Tshisekedi et Joseph Kabila pour préparer un dialogue national. Mais le pouvoir menace de poursuites ceux qui rencontreraient l'ancien président à Goma. Peut-on encore réunir les acteurs de cette crise autour d'une même table ? Et que devient l'avenir démocratique du pays à l'approche des élections de 2028 ?
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1d2fef02-dbbb-11f1-876c-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/NW285664-O-01-20261108-01.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/1d2fef02-dbbb-11f1-876c-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/NW285664-O-01-20261108-01.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">a499130a-dbbc-11f1-99e3-2b703d7534bc</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 21:37:48 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Fatimata WANE</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>RDC : dialogue impossible entre Tshisekedi, Kabila et l'opposition ?</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261108-rdc-dialogue-impossible-entre-tshisekedi-kabila-et-l-opposition</link><description>
En République démocratique du Congo, la crise politique s'intensifie sur fond de guerre dans l'Est. La coalition d'opposition C64 souhaite rencontrer le président Félix Tshisekedi et son prédécesseur Joseph Kabila pour préparer un dialogue national. Mais Kinshasa menace de poursuites les opposants qui iraient rencontrer l'ancien chef de l'État à Goma, où il dirige désormais un mouvement politico-militaire intégrant l'AFC/M23.

Entre guerre, divisions politiques, débat sur la Constitution et élections prévues en 2028, quelles sont les perspectives de sortie de crise ?

Décryptage avec Christian Moleka, politologue congolais et coordinateur de la Dynamique des politologues de la RDC, invité de Fatimata Wane dans le Journal de l'Afrique sur France 24.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/c5b7da0a-dbba-11f1-9ad4-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261108-214131-215019-CS.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.france24.com/media/display/c5b7da0a-dbba-11f1-9ad4-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/FR-20261108-214131-215019-CS.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">cb4fb96a-dbba-11f1-93d0-dfe47fa0192f</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 21:30:57 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>FRANCE24</dc:creator></item><item><category></category><title>Patronat et syndicats reçus lundi à Matignon : la colère va-t-elle retomber ?</title><link>https://www.france24.com/fr/vid%C3%A9o/20261108-patronat-et-syndicats-re%C3%A7us-lundi-%C3%A0-matignon-la-col%C3%A8re-va-t-elle-retomber</link><description>
Au menu de Présidentielle 2027: la conférence sociale organisée à Matignon, la démonstration de force de Jean-Luc Mélenchon et la cacophonie de la droite et du centre.

<rss version="2.0" xmlns:atom="http://www.w3.org/2005/Atom" xmlns:media="http://search.yahoo.com/mrss/" xmlns:dc="http://purl.org/dc/elements/1.1/"><channel><language>fr</language><title>L'actualité économique et politique en Europe - RFI</title><description>Suivez l'actualité en direct dédiée au continent Européen - Les derniers reportages, news et informations en continu en Europe, Emissions, Podcast, dossiers sur RFI.</description><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/</link><lastBuildDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:18:55 GMT</lastBuildDate><atom:link href="https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/rss" rel="self" type="application/rss+xml"/><item><category>Europe</category><title>Pologne: l'auteur de la fusillade à Cracovie est mort, annonce la police</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261109-pologne-l-auteur-de-la-fusillade-%C3%A0-cracovie-est-mort-annonce-la-police</link><description>
Il ne répondra jamais de ses actes : l'auteur de la tuerie qui a fait six morts et 15 blessés samedi 7 novembre à Cracovie, un Polonais de 24 ans grièvement blessé par des policiers, est mort ce lundi 9 novembre. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/a51ea9e8-db76-11f1-90b4-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26312287757514.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/a51ea9e8-db76-11f1-90b4-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26312287757514.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">4a74bf34-dc19-11f1-88b4-1d1d7415db57</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 09:13:06 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/a51ea9e8-db76-11f1-90b4-bf1914cabd52/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26312287757514.jpg">AP Photo/Beata Zawrzel - Beata Zawrzel</source><dc:creator>RFI avec AFP</dc:creator></item><item><category>La fabrique du monde</category><title>En Pologne, la Coalition des volontaires de la parole aux actes</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/en-pologne-la-coalition-des-volontaires-de-la-parole-aux-actes</link><description>
Lundi 9 novembre, 2 800 militaires venus de dix pays entament des exercices conjoints en Pologne, première concrétisation de la Coalition des volontaires créée en 2025 pour soutenir l’Ukraine. Un test grandeur nature pour la Force multinationale pour l’Ukraine (FMU), qui veut montrer sa capacité à intervenir en Ukraine en cas de cessez-le-feu avec la Russie.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/9ed9fdcc-d742-11f1-aed7-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C7KT79E.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/9ed9fdcc-d742-11f1-aed7-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-C7KT79E.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">61905db0-dc12-11f1-8e0e-b104af57d4e2</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 08:22:20 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Daniel Vallot</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>Ukraine: plus de 600 000 habitants sans électricité après l'intensification des frappes russes</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261109-ukraine-plus-de-600-000-habitants-sans-%C3%A9lectricit%C3%A9-apr%C3%A8s-l-intensification-des-frappes-russes</link><description>
Le président ukrainien, Volodymyr Zelensky, a accusé ce week-end Moscou d’intensifier ses frappes en Ukraine afin d’affaiblir Kiev avant les négociations qui ont lieu à Abou Dhabi les 10 et 11 novembre. Ce lundi 9 novembre, plus de 600 000 Ukrainiens se réveillent sans électricité dans l'est du pays. En réalité, c'est tout le pays qui est concerné. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/b1f8357a-dc0d-11f1-89ec-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26311445825483.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/b1f8357a-dc0d-11f1-89ec-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26311445825483.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">8b9840e2-dc0c-11f1-8423-11f323875a0a</guid><pubDate>Mon, 09 Nov 2026 07:45:12 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/b1f8357a-dc0d-11f1-89ec-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26311445825483.jpg">AP Photo/Dan Bashakov - Dan Bashakov</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>Pologne: autour de l'attentat de Cracovie, la désinformation et la récupération politique à l'œuvre</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261108-pologne-autour-de-l-attentat-de-cracovie-la-d%C3%A9sinformation-et-la-r%C3%A9cup%C3%A9ration-politique-%C3%A0-l-%C5%93uvre</link><description>
Après le choc de la fusillade sur la place centrale de Cracovie samedi 7 novembre, l'heure est déjà à la récupération politique dans une Pologne déjà fracturée par une polarisation extrême, à un an des élections législatives. Alors que le gouvernement pointe un assaillant fasciné par l'idéologie ultranationaliste, la télévision proche de l'extrême droite accuse les autorités d'avoir monopolisé la police à Varsovie pour défendre ses intérêts, laissant Cracovie vulnérable durant le week-end.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/dff42bc0-dbb1-11f1-b289-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/POLOGNE-ATTENTAT-CRACOVIE.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/dff42bc0-dbb1-11f1-b289-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/POLOGNE-ATTENTAT-CRACOVIE.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">e86da934-dbb1-11f1-b3a7-b1e5cd2ee320</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 20:21:27 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/dff42bc0-dbb1-11f1-b289-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/POLOGNE-ATTENTAT-CRACOVIE.jpg">REUTERS - Jakub Porzycki</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>Qui sont les candidats en lice pour succéder à Christine Lagarde à la tête de la BCE?</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261108-qui-sont-les-candidats-en-lice-pour-succ%C3%A9der-%C3%A0-christine-lagarde-%C3%A0-la-t%C3%AAte-de-la-bce</link><description>
Qui succédera à Christine Lagarde à la tête de la Banque centrale européenne (BCE) ? Après l'annonce fin octobre 2026 de son départ anticipé, prévu le 7 février 2027, deux candidats sont officiellement en lice : le Néerlandais Klaas Knot et l'Espagnol Pablo Hernandez de Cos. Les négociations entre les 21 pays membres de la zone euro débutent ce lundi 9 novembre à Bruxelles. Une décision est attendue avant la fin de l'année, mais la nomination pourrait prendre du temps.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/ac6e64c6-db90-11f1-bb5d-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/BCE-LAGARDE-CHRISTINE.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/ac6e64c6-db90-11f1-bb5d-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/BCE-LAGARDE-CHRISTINE.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">17222526-db8e-11f1-8479-ed68cd78a514</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 16:29:13 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/ac6e64c6-db90-11f1-bb5d-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/BCE-LAGARDE-CHRISTINE.jpg">REUTERS - Heiko Becker</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>Guerre en Ukraine: les Européens, dont la France, seront «représentés» lors des négociations à Abou Dhabi</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261108-guerre-en-ukraine-les-europ%C3%A9ens-dont-la-france-seront-repr%C3%A9sent%C3%A9s-lors-des-n%C3%A9gociations-%C3%A0-abou-dhabi</link><description>
Les Européens et la France seront « représentés » lors des pourparlers entre Russes et Ukrainiens qui doivent se dérouler les 10 et 11 novembre 2026 à Abou Dhabi sous médiation américaine, a annoncé, dimanche 8 novembre, le chef de la diplomatie française sur RTL/Public Sénat.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/be9b7a98-7f02-11f1-a876-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26186543888441.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/be9b7a98-7f02-11f1-a876-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26186543888441.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">bd23a5d4-db71-11f1-bbc0-d704e5ecf874</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 12:47:49 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/be9b7a98-7f02-11f1-a876-005056a97e36/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26186543888441.jpg">© Ukrainian 65th Mechanized brigade / Andriy Andriyenko via AP</source><dc:creator>RFI avec AFP</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>Russie: avec la menace de drones ukrainiens sur l'espace aérien, les voyageurs doivent s'adapter</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261108-russie-avec-la-menace-de-drones-ukrainiens-sur-l-espace-a%C3%A9rien-les-voyageurs-doivent-s-adapter</link><description>
« Le ciel russe devient un endroit dangereux. » Ces mots en forme de menace ont été prononcés début septembre 2026 par le président ukrainien Volodymyr Zelensky. À l'époque, les alertes aux drones perturbaient déjà régulièrement le trafic aérien en Russie. Aujourd'hui, la situation s'est aggravée. Selon des données compilées par des spécialistes, 34 000 vols auraient été reportés ou annulés en octobre, sans décourager, pour l'instant, des voyageurs qui s'adaptent à la nouvelle donne.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/4b25f2d2-db50-11f1-a2bd-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D49B8WG.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/4b25f2d2-db50-11f1-a2bd-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D49B8WG.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">9d83fe98-db50-11f1-ac0f-95014ee89d4b</guid><pubDate>Sun, 08 Nov 2026 09:34:17 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/4b25f2d2-db50-11f1-a2bd-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D49B8WG.jpg">© AFP</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>Lignes de défense</category><title>La Force multinationale pour l'Ukraine s'incarne en Pologne avec l'exercice militaire «Koalicja»</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/lignes-de-d%C3%A9fense/20261107-la-force-multinationale-pour-l-ukraine-s-incarne-en-pologne-avec-l-exercice-militaire-koalicja</link><description>
L'exercice militaire « Koalicja » (« coalition » en polonais) commence ce lundi 9 novembre en Pologne. C'est le premier du genre pour la Force multinationale pour l'Ukraine. Pendant deux semaines, les alliés de Kiev, pilotés par la France et le Royaume-Uni, vont mener des manœuvres grandeur nature destinées à éprouver leur aptitude à se déployer et opérer ensemble. Un exercice pour démontrer l'unité de la Force multinationale pour l'Ukraine, malgré certains désaccords.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/31f428ac-dab9-11f1-9f3b-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/Un-exercice-de-tir-r%C3%A9unissant-des-troupes-lituaniennes-et-fran%C3%A7aises-ainsi-que-des-alli%C3%A9s-de-l-OTAN-%C3%A0-Pabrade-en-Lituanie-le-16-septembre-2026.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/31f428ac-dab9-11f1-9f3b-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/Un-exercice-de-tir-r%C3%A9unissant-des-troupes-lituaniennes-et-fran%C3%A7aises-ainsi-que-des-alli%C3%A9s-de-l-OTAN-%C3%A0-Pabrade-en-Lituanie-le-16-septembre-2026.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">6e84cf7c-d9f8-11f1-b4c5-81410d98422a</guid><pubDate>Sat, 07 Nov 2026 22:58:01 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Franck Alexandre</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>Pologne: six morts dans une fusillade à Cracovie, le tireur «fasciné par les idéologies d'extrême droite»</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261107-pologne-fusillade-dans-le-centre-de-cracovie-le-tireur-interpell%C3%A9</link><description>
Une fusillade a éclaté, samedi 7 novembre à Cracovie, la deuxième ville de Pologne. Un homme a ouvert le feu sur la place du marché principal de Cracovie et a tiré au hasard sur des passants. Selon le dernier bilan de la police, au moins six personnes ont été tuées, et on compte une dizaine de blessés. Le tireur a été interpellé. Deux jours de deuil national ont été décrétés. Ce dimanche, le parquet annonce ouvrir une enquête pour « terrorisme ».
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/52e20d82-dae5-11f1-96d0-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/POLOGNE-CRACOVIE-FUSILLADE-POLICE.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/52e20d82-dae5-11f1-96d0-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/POLOGNE-CRACOVIE-FUSILLADE-POLICE.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">3f9a0606-dabf-11f1-ba57-bb051890a6f2</guid><pubDate>Sat, 07 Nov 2026 15:24:18 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/52e20d82-dae5-11f1-96d0-695cb59fade5/w:1024/p:16x9/POLOGNE-CRACOVIE-FUSILLADE-POLICE.jpg">REUTERS - Jakub Porzycki</source><dc:creator>RFI</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>Ukraine: de nouvelles frappes nocturnes russes «massives» contre des infrastructures énergétiques</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261107-ukraine-de-nouvelles-frappes-nocturnes-russes-massives-contre-des-infrastructures-%C3%A9nerg%C3%A9tiques</link><description>
De nouvelles frappes russes « massives » ont visé, dans la nuit du vendredi 6 au samedi 7 novembre, des infrastructures énergétiques en Ukraine, entraînant des coupures de courant dans cinq régions, a indiqué le ministère ukrainien de l'Énergie, dans un communiqué.
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/c149d688-da9a-11f1-8a3e-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6QL4WF.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/c149d688-da9a-11f1-8a3e-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6QL4WF.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">d7e33e42-da9b-11f1-b700-23091daeb101</guid><pubDate>Sat, 07 Nov 2026 12:02:59 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/c149d688-da9a-11f1-8a3e-a575454bc579/w:1024/p:16x9/000-D6QL4WF.jpg">© AFP/Vladyslav Musiienko</source><dc:creator>RFI avec AFP</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>De l'occupation russe à Kiev, le long périple des animaux d'Olechky</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261107-de-l-occupation-russe-%C3%A0-kiev-le-long-p%C3%A9riple-des-animaux-d-olechky</link><description>
Ce 31 octobre, ils ont été les premiers à franchir la frontière nord de l'Ukraine, après avoir parcouru plus de 2 200 kilomètres pour quitter les territoires occupés par la Russie. </description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/291fde0c-d9d2-11f1-b439-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/Evacuated-Pets-Oleshky-RFI.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/291fde0c-d9d2-11f1-b439-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/Evacuated-Pets-Oleshky-RFI.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">63d72628-d9d1-11f1-9fdc-653db0cfaaae</guid><pubDate>Sat, 07 Nov 2026 05:57:01 GMT</pubDate><source url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/291fde0c-d9d2-11f1-b439-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/Evacuated-Pets-Oleshky-RFI.jpg">© Emmanuelle Chaze / RFI</source><dc:creator>Emmanuelle Chaze</dc:creator></item><item><category>Reportage international</category><title>La diaspora russe en Serbie touchée par la faillite d'Alta Banka</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/reportage-international/20261106-la-diaspora-russe-en-serbie-touch%C3%A9e-par-la-faillite-d-alta-banka</link><description>
En Serbie, une banque d'un proche de l'ancien président Aleksandar Vucic a été suspendue, puis mise en faillite par la Banque centrale, pour soupçons de fuites de capitaux vers l'étranger. Son propriétaire a été arrêté. Cette banque, Alta Banka, était quasiment la seule à accepter d'ouvrir des comptes pour la très importante diaspora russe en Serbie. On parle de 250 000 personnes dans ce petit pays, qui ont fui la Russie depuis le déclenchement de la guerre en Ukraine. Résultat : cette communauté est particulièrement touchée par la faillite de cette banque. Beaucoup de Russes se sont retrouvés sans moyens de paiement, voire spoliés de leurs économies. 
</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/7f026f36-d6e1-11f1-800f-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26306602852820.jpg"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/7f026f36-d6e1-11f1-800f-1beafce15fea/w:1024/p:16x9/AP26306602852820.jpg" type="image/jpeg" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">45491248-da26-11f1-aabe-c375d89a5c64</guid><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 23:04:50 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Laurent Rouy</dc:creator></item><item><category>Ici l'Europe</category><title>Josep Borrell : «Trump sera plus contraint, mais fera jouer son veto»</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/podcasts/ici-l-europe/20261106-josep-borrell-trump-sera-plus-contraint-mais-fera-jouer-son-veto</link><description>

</description><media:thumbnail url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/88ee1a20-d9f9-11f1-80bb-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/PHOTO-JOSEP-BORRELL-1.png"/><enclosure url="https://s.rfi.fr/media/display/88ee1a20-d9f9-11f1-80bb-d18c5759e759/w:1024/p:16x9/PHOTO-JOSEP-BORRELL-1.png" type="image/png" length="0"/><guid isPermaLink="false">5eb9fed2-da11-11f1-a7e9-0514bb3ecff9</guid><pubDate>Fri, 06 Nov 2026 20:05:50 GMT</pubDate><dc:creator>Caroline de Camaret (France 24)</dc:creator></item><item><category>Europe</category><title>L'UE exige que TikTok modifie ses flux personnalisés, accusés d'effets «nocifs»</title><link>https://www.rfi.fr/fr/europe/20261106-l-ue-exige-que-tiktok-modifie-ses-flux-personnalis%C3%A9s-accus%C3%A9s-d-effets-nocifs</link><description>
L'Union européenne a sommé, vendredi 6 novembre, le réseau social TikTok de modifier radicalement ses flux de vidéos personnalisés, et plus particulièrement la fonction « pour toi ».
